structuredData.description: CARE Janwar is an open-source animal health and veterinary EMR blueprint for clinics, field visits, vaccination, diagnostics, pharmacy, billing, inventory, and dashboards.

hero.title: Open infrastructure for animal health care.
hero.body: CARE Janwar adapts CARE Core for veterinary clinics, public animal-health programs, field visits, vaccination, diagnostics, pharmacy, billing, inventory, and program dashboards.

sharedLayer.title: Shared operational layer
sharedLayer.text: Records, encounters, vaccination, pharmacy, labs, billing, field visits, and dashboards stay connected.

overview.title: Animal health needs records, workflows, stock, and program visibility.
overview.body: Veterinary care is more than a visit note. It involves owners, keepers, locations, species, vaccination schedules, medicines, lab results, field teams, public programs, and operational reporting. CARE Janwar packages those workflows on the same open foundation.

what.question: What is CARE Janwar?
what.answer: CARE Janwar is a CARE Core blueprint for veterinary and public animal-health workflows. It adapts CARE concepts such as records, encounters, forms, orders, pharmacy, inventory, billing, reports, access control, and dashboards for animal health settings.

separate.question: Is CARE Janwar a separate platform?
separate.answer: It is best treated as a solution built on CARE Core, not a disconnected product. The deployment can use veterinary-specific records, forms, terminology, reports, and workflows while continuing to strengthen the shared CARE architecture.

programs.question: Can it support public animal-health programs?
programs.answer: Yes. The blueprint can support vaccination campaigns, field visits, public animal hospitals, lab workflows, pharmacy and inventory, district dashboards, and program reporting when localized for a specific program.

judgment.question: Does this replace veterinary judgment?
judgment.answer: No. CARE Janwar records and coordinates workflows. AI, where used, should remain assistive, reviewed, role-governed, and audit-aware.

final.title: Build animal-health workflows on the same open foundation.
final.body: CARE Janwar gives implementation partners and public programs a starting point for veterinary records, field workflows, vaccination, diagnostics, pharmacy, inventory, billing, and program visibility.
